hook: Flying into Harvey's eye, one day before landfall.
narration: This plane flew into Hurricane Harvey's eye the day before it hit Texas as a Category 4.
NOAA forty-two took off from Lakeland, Florida, with four storm scientists aboard.
Inside the eye, the clouds rise all around the plane like the walls of a stadium.
Crews fly in on purpose. [short pause] The radar in the tail maps the storm's winds from the inside.
outcome: The crew made it through Harvey's eye on that first pass.
title: Flying into Hurricane Harvey's eye
description:
NOAA's WP-3D Orion hurricane hunter NOAA42 makes its first pass through the eye of Hurricane Harvey on Aug. 24, 2017, the day before Harvey made landfall in Texas as a Category 4.

extra_sources.excerpt: N42RF is flying an EMC-tasked Tail Doppler Radar mission into Harvey. This flight took off from Lakeland Linder Regional Airport in Lakeland, FL around 1400 UTC (10 AM ET). Four HRD scientists will be on this flight.
Seven years ago, on August 25, 2017, Hurricane Harvey made landfall in Texas. Hurricane Harvey became the first Category 4 storm to strike the United States since 2004
